change_kind.description: R-A (Idan, 2026-09-17): WHAT moved — a FINER axis than `kind`, which names which detector spoke. Additive and OPTIONAL: set on MCP findings only (definition_change carries wording|input|output|catalog, output_mismatch carries value, stale_client carries observed_failure); absent on the HTTP/OpenAPI kinds and on findings from older collectors, so readers must tolerate its absence. A kind never implies a severity.

via_dispatch.description: R-E (2026-09-17), additive and optional: the dispatcher tool a call went through when detection attributed it to the inner tool a recorded search result named.

source.description: Additive and optional, on definition_change: tools_list (a complete observed catalog; absence means this) or search_result (definitions a discovery meta-tool returned).

completeness.description: Additive and optional: complete, or partial — a search result is partial by nature and never a source of removals.
